title: fraxinus caudata
intro: Fraxinus caudata, commonly known as Manchurian ash, is a deciduous tree native to East Asia. The health benefits of Fraxinus caudata include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus caudata include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential application in modern medicine to treat cardiovascular and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Fraxinus caudata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
